# Pinned to tracebloc-engine's runtime versions so CI validates templates
# against what the fleet actually runs (backend#2658, backend#2752).
#
# Unpinned, CI resolved whatever PyPI served that day while the engine pins
# the versions below -- so a survival template could pass here and be broken
# on the edge, silently, and only for customers. The pytorch env had the same
# gap and it fired: sapiens' LoRA target_modules were written for transformers
# 5.12's attention naming against the engine's 5.8.0, CI went green, and the
# template could not be constructed on the edge at all (backend#2641).
#
# Both come from tracebloc-engine's use_cases/requirements.txt. Bump them
# together with the engine's pins, never ahead of them. That ordering is the
# entire point -- and it is a comment, not a check, until backend#2753 lands
# the scheduled drift detection.
#
# pytest is deliberately NOT pinned: it does not appear in the engine's
# requirements, so there is nothing to sync it to, and inventing a pin would
# assert an agreement that does not exist. Same call as the pytorch env.
pytest
lifelines==0.30.3
scikit-survival==0.27.0
